title: Microbe/Phage Wastewater DNA/RNA Concentration and Extraction
author: Brett Rasile

steps.title: Prepare Wastewater Sample
steps.instruction: Collect 500 mL of wastewater in a 500 mL or 1 L plastic sample bottle.

steps.title: Prepare BSRV Vaccine Dilution
steps.instruction: Create a 1:100 dilution of Zoetis Bovine Rhinotracheitis-Parainfluzena-Respiratory Syncytial Virus (BRSV) Vaccine in H2O.

steps.title: Spike Wastewater Sample
steps.instruction: Spike the wastewater sample with 1:100 BSRV to achieve a final concentration of 1 µL/mL.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 1:100 BSRV to 500 mL of wastewater (adjust volumes as needed to maintain 1 µL/mL ratio).
Mix by aggressively inverting the bottle several times or shaking.

steps.title: Settle and Aliquot Sample
steps.instruction: Allow the spiked wastewater to sediment and transfer a portion to a conical tube.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the sample at room temperature (RT) for a minimum of 00:10:00.
Use a 25 mL serological pipette to gently transfer the top 40 mL of wastewater to a 50 mL conical tube, avoiding the sediment at the bottom.

steps.title: Concentrate Particles with Magnetic Nanotrap
steps.instruction: Use Ceres Magnetic Nanotrap® particles to concentrate the sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µL of Ceres Magnetic Nanotrap® particles to the 40 mL wastewater aliquot.
Place conical tubes into custom magnet racks and incubate at RT for a minimum of 20 minutes until the supernatant is relatively clear.
While keeping tubes fixed to the magnets, carefully pour off the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Wash and Resuspend Particles
steps.instruction: Wash the Magnetic Nanotrap® pellets using Buffer MWA1.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of Buffer MWA1 to the tubes.
Vortex to resuspend the pellets.
Incubate for 00:10:00 at RT.
Place tubes on custom magnet racks to separate the particles.
Invert the samples several times to incorporate the particles and incubate for 20 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Transfer Lysate to Deep Well Plate
steps.instruction: Separate particles and transfer the lysate for RNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Place tubes on magnets and transfer 450 µL of lysate to a 2 mL deep well plate.
Use barcode labels to transfer sample IDs to a LIMS program.

steps.title: Bind RNA to NucleoMag B-Beads
steps.instruction: Bind the RNA using NucleoMag® B-Beads and Buffer MWA2.

substeps.instruction: Add 475 µL of Buffer MWA2 and 25 µL of NucleoMag® B-Beads to the lysate in the deep well plate.
Shake the plate for 00:05:00 at 1400 rpm.
Place the plate on a plate magnet for at least 00:05:00 until beads completely precipitate.
Remove the supernatant using a multichannel pipette, ensuring no beads are removed.

steps.title: Wash Beads with Buffer MWA3
steps.instruction: Perform two wash cycles using Buffer MWA3.

substeps.instruction: Add 850 µL of Buffer MWA3 to each well.
Shake the plate for 00:02:00 at 1400 rpm.
Place the plate on a plate magnet for at least 00:02:00.
Remove the supernatant with a multichannel pipette.
Repeat the addition of 850 µL Buffer MWA3, shaking (00:02:00 at 1400 rpm), magnetic separation (00:02:00), and supernatant removal.

steps.title: Wash Beads with Buffer MWA4
steps.instruction: Perform a final wash with Buffer MWA4 and dry the beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 850 µL of Buffer MWA4 to each well.
Shake the plate for 00:02:00 at 1400 rpm.
Place the plate on a plate magnet for 00:02:00.
Remove as much supernatant as possible using a multichannel pipette to avoid PCR failure.
Place the plate on a shaker at 56 °C for approximately 30 minutes until beads are thoroughly air-dried.

steps.title: Elute and Collect RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the RNA from the beads and transfer to an elution plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 60 µL of RNase-free H2O to each well.
Shake the plate for 00:05:00 at 500 rpm.
Place the plate on a plate magnet for 00:02:00 to separate the beads.
Transfer the eluted RNA to a 96-well elution plate.
